name: media-mcp-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the AVCLabs media MCP servers: per-function packages (video, image, SAM3), a shared core, and the legacy all-in-one server

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/video-mcp && npm run build -w packages/image-mcp && npm run build -w packages/sam3-mcp && npm run build -w packages/media-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/tests/*.test.mjs packages/video-mcp/tests/*.test.mjs packages/image-mcp/tests/*.test.mjs packages/sam3-mcp/tests/*.test.mjs packages/media-mcp/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.release:verify: npm run check:release && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm test && npm pack --dry-run --workspaces
